bifrost: No app-facing record-sync SDK. Local pieces: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, keychain.rs, share.rs, url.rs; ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud (server-side contacts/calendar sync)
summary: BifrOSt has no generic record database, subscriptions or sync engine for apps. The cloud service in bifrost-cloud syncs contacts and calendar over ETag/If-Match HTTP APIs, and the shell backs up data to a local file.

features.note: no per-app container or database scopes
server stores two fixed object types, not app-defined records
no file attachment to synced records
no change tokens, push or incremental fetch for apps
optimistic concurrency per object, internal to contacts and calendar

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (local share sheet, not record sharing)

features.note: accounts exist, no app discovery API

features.apple: encrypted values, access and deletion articles
features.note: local backup only; keychain has no iCloud sync (docs/bifrost-ui.md)
local only, not a CloudKit counterpart

gaps: App record database with zones and queries
